description: Robustness of the memory router against untrusted / malformed LLM output: reasoning-leak, CJK-leak, empty/invalid entries, malformed JSON, and null/non-array shapes. Links to 12 §4 (recalled memory is untrusted). Prompt-injection round-trip-inert, delimiter-collision escaping and recall caps (14 §6) are v2-spec requirements absent in v1 and registered as GAP-05. T14-08 closes the formatter-level slice (`adversarial.recall.*`: additionalContext sanitization/escaping/caps, spec 11 §5/12 §4) with real unit tests in `crates/memory/src/recall/format.rs`; the full end-to-end corpus (stored memory -> real op engine -> wired recall -> inert output) remains T16-04's, per the gap register's own `resolves_in`.
